p='big.py'; s=open(p).read()

new = '''chunk = 500_000_000
size_line = format(chunk, 'x').encode() + b'\\r\\n'

tail = b'0\\r\\nX: y\\r\\n\\r\\n'
source = ('b"%s"' % head.decode('ascii').encode('unicode_escape').decode())

document = doc([['CH', chunk_source], ['HDR', source]],

                                       'data_to_transfered': [[':method', 'POST']]}],
                           method='GET', target='/a', host='h')],
               channels=[{'name': 'edge', 'parts': [
                   {'case': 'copper', 'data': '{{HDR}}'},
                   {'case': None, 'data': size_line.decode()},
                   {'case': 'copper', 'data': '{{CH}}'},
                   {'case': None, 'data': '\\r\\n'},
                   {'case': None, 'data': size_line.decode()},
                   {'case': 'copper', 'data': '{{CH}}'},
                   {'case': None, 'data': '\\r\\n'},
                   {'case': 'copper', 'data': tail.decode()}]}])
start = time.time()
out = run(document)
elapsed = time.time() - start

    check('chunked published', row['error'], 'a request')

    check('chunked owners', record['owners'],
          [['copper', len(head) + 2 * chunk + len(tail)],
           [None, 2 * len(size_line) + 4]])
    check('chunked flags', record['flags'], ['identity', 'mixed_owner'])
    check('chunked error', row['error'], None)
    check('chunked committed', row['committed'],
          [0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 1])
    check('chunked host/headers',
